acts.title: Act I: Basic Forms
acts.blurb: Guns, hedges and the first pushpin.

acts.title: Act III: Full Spectrum
acts.blurb: Look up, look after, look out.

mod_helm_tin_hat.name: Tin Hat
mod_helm_tin_hat.blurb: A helmet that is a biscuit tin lid. The Soldier Workshop has it now. Biscuits sold separately.

mod_visor_eyeshade.name: Eyeshade Visor
mod_visor_eyeshade.blurb: A green eyeshade for the Soldier Workshop. Sleeve garters not included.

mod_goggles.name: Goggles
mod_goggles.blurb: Driving goggles for the Soldier Workshop. They do not make the bridge any wider.

mod_back_radio.name: Back Radio
mod_back_radio.blurb: A radio backpack with a whip antenna. The antenna has a bulb on it and no flag.

mod_hard_hat.name: Hard Hat
mod_hard_hat.blurb: A yellow hard hat with a chin strap. It will not stop a mine. It looks like it might.

mod_aviator_goggles.name: Aviator Goggles
mod_aviator_goggles.blurb: Flying goggles for the Soldier Workshop, earned at the Airfield Open Day.

mod_wrench_big.name: Big Wrench
mod_wrench_big.blurb: A wrench the length of a bench. It repairs nothing in the Workshop and everything in the matinee.

text.title: Boot Camp Dropout
text.blurb: Win the exercise. Live fire, dead dummies.

briefing.text: BOOT CAMP! I have a headset! It has a little arm for the mouth! Can you hear me? Over!
They hand us a rifle and call it a lesson. A rifle is a spear that has given up on being brave. Is that progress?
Eight rounds in the magazine. The ninth click is the one that gets you. It is in the manual. Nobody has the manual.

victory.text: The yellow line HELD! Nobody reloaded in the open on purpose! The dummies are in a better place, which is the floor!

defeat.text: You reloaded in the open. I wrote 'reload' on your hand. The ink ran.

stars.text: Win the exercise. Live fire, dead dummies.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) still standing. Nobody is graded on biscuits.
Win while spending 2,250 rq or less. Frugal is the new brave.

reward.title: Reluctant Recruit
reward.blurb: A helmet that is a biscuit tin lid. The Soldier Workshop has it now. Biscuits sold separately.

blind.why: The blind army has no wheels: it stands in the open, reloads together, and the trolleys and the second row walk in.

rules: Troopers fire in two-round bursts and run dry after eight: the pips under a soldier are the magazine, and empty means kneeling.
Trolleys arrive at thirty seconds and outrun bullets. A runabout beats a trolley; so does a rifleman who is not reloading.
Star 3: spend at most 2,250 of your 3,000 rq.

beats.text: Pick a card, then drag across the field to draw a line. It looks simple because it is.
beats.hint: Choose the line brush, then drag along the yellow line.

beats.text: FIGHT! Press the button, watch the line, and try not to narrate it.
Space pauses. The speed keys change the pace. Nobody asked me, so I am telling you.
Keys 1 to 6 are your god powers. Press 1.
beats.hint: Number keys 1 to 6 cast god powers. Each has a cooldown.

beats.text: THAT is how you win a battle! Do it again, smarter, for the stars!
Those little dots under a soldier are BULLETS! Eight dots, eight bullets! Dots gone, confidence gone!
beats.hint: Ammo pips under each shooter show the magazine.

beats.text: The rifle is empty. Is it still a rifle, or merely a stick with opinions?
beats.hint: Ammo pips under a soldier show the magazine. Empty: kneel and reload.

beats.text: A TROLLEY! Fast and wobbly! Bring a runabout and do not stand in a row!
beats.hint: Trolleys outrun bullets. Shoot the front rank, or meet them with wheels.

beats.text: He RELOADED in the open! We have punished the click!
beats.hint: Hit enemies while they reload: they cannot answer.

beats.text: Four of them are reloading at once. I counted. They were counting too, in a different order.
beats.hint: Reloading together leaves a gap. Let one rank fire while another reloads.
beats.when: three or more own units reload within one second

exceptions.why: Hay rows behind the enemy zone: cover previewed, never used by the fight (outline 0.3).
Sandbag demo bay on each flank, at least 20 u off the lanes: previewed, never used.

lines.text: Live fire! The dummies are UP! The dummies are down! Nobody was consulted!
A cardboard soldier stands up to be shot at. Is that bravery, or a job description?
They were never going to win. I said so to the dummies. They did not read it.

setpiece.notes: Trigger: the first projectile_launch of the battle (existing event, no script). Shot looks along the firing line toward the dummies, rises over 3.5 s to the default framing. mod_popup_clack x9 (shuffle bag). Nine dummies spring up and fold to confetti.

text.title: The Hedgerow Picnic (Unscheduled)
text.blurb: Hold the picnic blanket for 90 seconds. The clock stops while an enemy stands on it.

briefing.text: A PICNIC! On a hill! With hedges! The sandwiches have been tactically placed!
The hedge does not stop the bullet. It persuades it to reconsider. Is that not the whole of diplomacy?
Stand behind the hedge. In front of the hedge is where it happens. I drew a diagram. Brutus ate the diagram.

victory.text: The hamper is in PIECES, the hill is ours, and somebody has handed me a sandwich!

defeat.text: They took the hill. They ate the sandwiches. I said they would eat the sandwiches.

stars.text: Hold the picnic blanket for 90 seconds. The clock stops while an enemy stands on it.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive. The hedge does not count as army.
Take no more than six hits while reloading. Reload behind the hedge, not in front of it.

reward.title: Hedge Trimmer
reward.blurb: A green eyeshade for the Soldier Workshop. Sleeve garters not included.

missions.botsWhy: A patient army behind hedges holds the blanket; the hill is the objective, not the kills.

blind.why: The blind army camps on the road side of the hedge and is flanked in cover (one-type roster: the difference is placement behaviour, not composition).

objective.text: Hold the picnic blanket for 90 seconds

rules: Hold the blanket for 90 seconds in total; an enemy standing on it stops the clock.
Hedges, hay bales and sandbags are cover: hits from the front do half damage. Cover faces one way.
Three waves, 28 seconds apart. Star 3: take at most six hits while your own units are reloading.

beats.text: A hedge does not stop the bullet. It persuades it to reconsider. Is that not the whole of diplomacy?
beats.hint: Cyan corner brackets mark cover. Stand behind it, not beside it.

beats.text: That hit was halved. The bag took half. I mention it because the bag deserves credit.
beats.hint: Cyan brackets mean cover: hits from the front do half damage. A flanked unit loses it.

beats.text: FLANKED! The hedge has a back door and they found it!
beats.hint: Cover faces one way. Keep units behind the hedge, not beside it.

beats.text: Hold the blanket for 90 seconds in total. An enemy standing on it stops the clock.
beats.hint: Hold the blanket for 90 seconds in total. An enemy standing on it stops the clock.

lines.text: A stray round has found the hamper! The sandwiches are airborne! This is a picnic with CONSEQUENCES!
Even a sandwich, in the end, takes cover. Where was its hedge?
The hamper was in the open. I said so about the hamper.

setpiece.notes: Fires from the script event hamper_bursts (wave 2 arrives, prop destroy). Slow push-in from behind the middle hedge to the blanket. mod_sandwich_splat x3, a far mod_leaf_rustle.

missions.designAmendment: AM-2: blind swap is an identity (one-type roster); see missions_notes.md

text.title: The Long Trench (Pardon Our Mud)
text.blurb: Capture all three signal posts. Twelve seconds each, any order, mud included.

briefing.text: THE LONG TRENCH! Mud, wire, and a new feature called pinning, which is when they cannot lift their heads and, today, neither can I!
The machine gun does not kill the man. It persuades him to stay still. Is persuasion the weapon, and the bullet the footnote?
They pop up the moment you stop firing. Keep firing. I did not write that for fun.

victory.text: All three posts are OURS! The lamps changed sides! The mud remains neutral!

defeat.text: We advanced while they were not pinned. The pin was on the map. Not on them.

stars.text: Capture all three signal posts. Twelve seconds each, any order, mud included.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Spend at least 35 percent of your unit-seconds in cover. The trench lip is there for a reason.

reward.title: Pinned and Proud
reward.blurb: Red Tape for Quick Battle. Reloads take twice as long. Magazines hold twice as much. The announcer says 'in triplicate'.

blind.why: The blind army has no machine guns to pin with: it charges unpinned across no-man's land into 32 rifles.

rules: Hold each signal post's ring for 12 seconds to capture it; the lamp takes your team colour. Own all three at once to win.
Tripod gunners pin whatever they fire near: a pinned unit crouches, cannot advance and aims badly. Pin the trench, then flank it.
Cover halves hits from the front. Star 3: at least 35 percent of your unit-seconds in cover.

beats.text: A PUSHPIN! He is stuck to the map! He cannot advance! He cannot aim!
beats.hint: Pinned units duck, cannot advance and shoot wide. Pin first, then flank.

beats.text: Near-miss streaks fill the pin meter. You do not have to hit him to hold him.
beats.hint: Near-miss streaks fill the pin meter. You do not have to hit him to hold him.

beats.text: They pop up the moment you stop firing. Keep firing. I did not write that for fun.
beats.hint: A pin lasts 2.5 seconds after the last near miss.
beats.when: first unit released from a pin

beats.text: The machine gun does not kill the man. It persuades him to stay still. Is persuasion the weapon, and the bullet the footnote?
beats.when: first kill of a pinned unit by a unit not pinning it

beats.text: The red dot is a warning. It is also a promise.
beats.hint: A red dot on a target means a shot is one second away. Smoke and cover break it.

beats.text: Stand inside a post's ring for 12 seconds to capture it. The lamp takes your team colour.
beats.hint: Stand inside a post's ring for 12 seconds to capture it. The lamp takes your team colour.

exceptions.why: Area thrower with a 5 u minimum range, no groundOnly, no crater: the ladder enemy and the clumping foil, not the M5 lesson.
Hitscan sniper with minRange 10 (a shells field in outline 0.3): no arc, no crater, not the M5 lesson.

lines.text: The whistle! The smoke! Everybody goes OVER the top and nobody has checked what the top is!
Smoke hides the enemy. It also hides the plan. Which of them was more visible beforehand?
The smoke is theirs. It drifts toward us. I said it would drift toward us.

setpiece.notes: Fires from the script event over_the_top (first post captured; weather fog tint, visual only). Tracking shot along the trench lip looking at no-man's land. mod_whistle x3, mod_smoke_pop x4, a far mod_bugle_wrong.

missions.designAmendment: AM-3: A1/A3 capture markers and rule text; extra exception long_lens_sharpshooter; see missions_notes.md

text.title: A Bridge Slightly Too Far
text.blurb: Get the Parcel Van to the far bank. It drives itself once the road is clear.

briefing.text: A BRIDGE! The Parcel Van must cross it! Nobody knows what is in the Parcel! The van has not been told either!
What is a tank for? It is a house that wants to be a gun, and a gun that wants to stay home.
Armour has a front and a back. The dozer has a blade at the front. The drainpipes wait at the back. People always pick the back.

victory.text: ACROSS! The bridge is narrower than the brochure and wider than the tank! Barely!

defeat.text: The bridge now has a gap. Does a gap have a purpose? It seems to be a river.

stars.text: Get the Parcel Van to the far bank. It drives itself once the road is clear.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Win without losing a single Biscuit-Tin Tank. They are attached to the good biscuits.

reward.title: Bridge Burner (Not Literally)
reward.blurb: Driving goggles for the Soldier Workshop. They do not make the bridge any wider.

blind.why: The blind army lets the drainpipes hit the column side and parks tanks side-on at the exit; its carriers are flat-armour runabouts that never use a face.

objective.text: Get the Parcel Van across the bridge

rules: The Parcel Van drives itself over the bridge once nothing hostile stands near the way. If it is destroyed, you lose.
Tanks and vans have faces: the front shrugs bullets, the sides and rear do not. Present your front, hit their back.
Star 3: lose no Biscuit-Tin Tank.

beats.text: Plink. The rifle did one point. Is that damage, or a compliment?
beats.hint: Tank fronts shrug off bullets. Hit the side or rear, and present your own front.

beats.text: BONK! That is the rear! The rear is where the biscuits are!
beats.hint: An orange BONK means a side or rear hit: far more damage than the front.
beats.when: first side or rear hit on a vehicle

beats.text: The turret turns faster than the hull. A tank fires only when its barrel is aimed.
beats.hint: The turret turns faster than the hull. A tank fires only when its barrel is aimed.

beats.text: The Parcel Van drives itself once the road is clear. If it falls, you lose.
beats.hint: The Parcel Van drives itself once the road is clear. If it falls, you lose.

beats.text: The crew bailed out. They are fine. They are holding sandwiches.
beats.hint: A destroyed Lunchbox APC drops three dazed troopers

beats.text: A horse of men in a box. We keep returning to this shape.
The blade is the front. Do not argue with the front.
beats.hint: A Dozer Plough is armoured at the blade and soft at the sides and rear.
beats.when: first bullet on a dozer blade

exceptions.why: Hired area thrower with minRange 5 (declared in mission 3 already): no arc, no crater, not the M5 lesson.
Hired anti-tank launcher with minRange 6, a groundOnly rocket: no arc, no crater, not the M5 lesson.

lines.text: Armour has a front and a back. The blade is the front. We are at the back.
The dozer is coming through the barricade like a wall that took up running! Guard rails are SNAPPING!
A wall that moves is merely a door in a hurry. Who holds the other side of it?

setpiece.notes: Fires from the script event wrecking_toll (the van passes the midpoint, objective progress 0.5): the lead dozer shoulders through the far barricade (structDmg x3), guard rails and lamp posts snap, ground-shake event. mod_rail_snap x3.

missions.designAmendment: AM-4: A4 escort params, closed override of the Parcel Van, exceptions thrower and drainpipe; see missions_notes.md

text.title: Wagon Delivery (Fireworks Sold Separately)
text.blurb: Destroy all four boxcars. Their cargo is described as miscellaneous.

briefing.text: THE RAIL YARD! Four wagons, one filing cabinet, and the cabinet has a GUN in it!
A shell announces itself with a whistle and then arrives anyway. Is a warning that changes nothing still a warning?
The howitzer cannot hit anything close. Everything close will be a reporter. I said reporters.

victory.text: FOUR wagons! Four wagons of fireworks and toys! Somebody has just signed for the confetti!

defeat.text: They reached the guns. The guns were close. That is the whole problem with close.

stars.text: Destroy all four boxcars. Their cargo is described as miscellaneous.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Win without losing a Filing-Cabinet Howitzer. You have a pair, and both have already filed the paperwork.

reward.title: Wagon Master
reward.blurb: A radio backpack with a whip antenna. The antenna has a bulb on it and no flag.

missions.botsWhy: The greedy bot sends the guns forward with no screen and the reporters reach the minimum range, so its ceiling is lower than the default.

blind.why: The blind army sends the howitzers forward with no screen and lets the reporters reach the minimum range.

objective.text: Destroy the four boxcars in the far siding

rules: Destroy the four boxcars in the far siding; shells chew them from a distance.
A red ring and a rising whistle mean a shell lands in two seconds. Guns cannot hit inside their minimum range, and mortars cannot hit anything in the air. Screen the guns.
Star 3: lose no Filing-Cabinet Howitzer.

beats.text: That shell is in the air. In two seconds it will be on something. Not on anything close.
beats.hint: Artillery cannot hit inside its minimum range. Screen it. Craters change the ground.

beats.text: A mortar cannot hit what is near. It can only hit what is far. Is that a weapon, or an opinion?
beats.hint: Mortars cannot hit inside 14 units, the howitzer inside 26. Put riflemen in front.
beats.when: first target inside a gun minimum range

beats.text: He CALLED it in! Three shells, one pointing finger, zero responsibility!
beats.hint: The Signal Officer's strike lands after 2.2 seconds. Aim ahead of the target.

beats.text: Crews need 1.5 to 2.5 seconds to set up. Move a gun and it must set up again.
beats.hint: Crews need 1.5 to 2.5 seconds to set up. Move a gun and it must set up again.

beats.text: That shell had no sense of loyalty. It landed where it was told.
beats.hint: Shells hurt everyone inside the ring, friend or foe.

beats.text: Craters stay. Wheels route around them and boots slow down in them.
beats.hint: Craters stay. Wheels route around them and boots slow down in them.

beats.text: The reporters are running at the guns. The guns cannot shoot them. I said that was the plan.
beats.hint: Cub Reporters live inside a gun's minimum range. Keep riflemen in front of the guns.

lines.text: Wagon four goes up and they ALL go! Fireworks! Toy trains! A parade of cargo marked miscellaneous!
Cargo that was never described turns out to be a celebration. Was it ours to open?
Miscellaneous means someone did not want to write it down. I said so at the depot.

setpiece.notes: Fires when the fourth boxcar dies (prop_destroyed): every wagon pops open into fireworks and toys (cosmetic particle sheet). mod_firework_rocket x4, mod_party_horn x3, mod_wagon_pop x4.

lines.text: We go LIVE in five! Four! Technical difficulties!
A dish the size of a roof, pointed at us. Is it listening, or merely large?
The pulse every six seconds is the pin. I said pulse. I said six.

extraSetpieces.notes: Fires from the script event behemoth_advances (the second boxcar falls and the Behemoth first advances). Crane-down 4.0 s from (x 56, z 10, 14 u) to the dish at 5 u.

missions.designAmendment: AM-5: star 3 text two -> a pair (MS-K05); reporters_go at 75 s only; see missions_notes.md

text.title: Please Hold (The Switchboard)
text.blurb: Keep the Switchboard Tower standing through all four waves.

briefing.text: THE SWITCHBOARD! If it falls, there are no more calls! Hold the tower! And the line! Please HOLD!
A mine is a decision made earlier by somebody who is no longer present. Is that not what most laws are?
The sappers ring every mine with tape. The tape says Caution. Nobody reads the tape. I read the tape.

victory.text: The tower STANDS! Four waves, four mines, and one extremely satisfied switchboard!

defeat.text: The tower fell. The line is now in the hands of whoever answers it. Who answers it?

stars.text: Keep the Switchboard Tower standing through all four waves.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Hit enemy vehicles on the side or rear at least twelve times. Armour has a back; use it.

reward.title: Mine Host
reward.blurb: A yellow hard hat with a chin strap. It will not stop a mine. It looks like it might.

missions.botsWhy: The tower holds behind its sandbags; a passive army needs only mines to win.

blind.why: The blind army lays no mines when it matters: it has no Sappers, and the column is already on the avenue.

objective.text: Keep the Switchboard Tower standing through four waves

rules: Defend the Switchboard Tower through four waves; if it falls, you lose.
Four friendly mines lie on the main street, ringed with tape. A mine arms in three seconds and hurts whatever steps on it; Sappers lay up to four more.
Star 3: hit enemy vehicles on the side or rear at least twelve times.

beats.text: The light is blinking. It has decided. Do not stand where it has decided.
beats.hint: Mines arm after 3 seconds. Lay them early, off the lane your own units use.

beats.text: The tape says Caution. Nobody reads the tape. I read the tape.
beats.hint: Yellow tape rings mark mines. A blinking light means armed.

beats.text: BOING! That was a mine! It had tape and everything!
beats.hint: A mine hurts whatever steps on it once armed. Vehicles take extra.
beats.when: first mine trigger on an enemy

beats.text: Sappers lay up to four mines, three seconds to arm. Lay them before the column arrives.
beats.hint: Sappers lay up to four mines, three seconds to arm. Lay them before the column arrives.

beats.text: Keep the Switchboard standing. Its hit points sit on the HUD.
beats.hint: Keep the Switchboard standing. Its hit points sit on the HUD.

exceptions.why: Scripted unarmed passive flyover (air layer, request R3): the chopper cameo of the set-piece.

marginWaiver.reason: Mines (M11, landing #16) is the last module of the Modern E-FREEZE prefix, margin 0. Request R2 (M11 before M8) is open with SIM/COORD; M6 content is written against the spec/M mine contract and first runs at the mechanic slice.

lines.text: I filed a risk assessment on the helicopter. It came back stamped APPROVED. By the helicopter.
The tower is blinking! It is playing HOLD music! Is that a distress call or a concert?
There is a helicopter and it is not shooting. Is that mercy, or a scheduling conflict?

setpiece.notes: Fires from the script event hold_music (tower below 50 percent): the city PA plays hold music, the tower windows blink in time, the passive Fishbowl Chopper makes its unarmed pass. Orbit round the tower at radius 16 through 120 degrees.

missions.designAmendment: AM-6: A2 defend_core params and core marker; pre-laid mines have no MS field; see missions_notes.md

text.title: Airfield Open Day
text.blurb: Bring down Deputy Director Pellmell. He holds the control tower and a clipboard.

briefing.text: AIRFIELD OPEN DAY! The flypast is ours! Please keep all arms inside the helicopter!
Their cannons cannot shoot upwards. A cannon that cannot look up is a cannon with excellent manners.
I filed a risk assessment on the helicopter currently overhead. It was approved. By the helicopter. Over.

victory.text: Fifty-three flights delayed, none landed. A perfect record.

defeat.text: Pellmell is STILL standing under his tower! The flypast has been moved to next year!

stars.text: Bring down Deputy Director Pellmell. He holds the control tower and a clipboard.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Win without losing a Spotter Balloon. It is a buff on a string and everyone is looking at it.

reward.title: Frequent Flyer
reward.blurb: Airmail for Quick Battle: a 40-damage parcel lands every twenty seconds, on whoever is underneath. Insurance sold separately.

blind.why: The blind army ignores the air layer and the Spot ring: raw drones in place of the buff balloons, no one kept behind the line.

rules: Kill the Deputy Director; the rest of his army does not matter, but it will try to matter.
Air units fly over ground-only guns: howitzers and mortars cannot shoot up. Tripod gunners and Parasol Missileers can, so remove them first.
Star 3: lose no Spotter Balloon.

beats.text: AIRCRAFT! Overhead! Your mortars cannot see them, which is unfortunate for the mortars!
beats.hint: Air units fly over artillery. Parasols, machine guns and rifles can hit them.

beats.text: A shadow on the ground marks an air unit. It shrinks as the unit climbs.
beats.hint: A shadow on the ground marks an air unit. It shrinks as the unit climbs.

beats.text: Their cannons cannot shoot upwards. A cannon that cannot look up is a cannon with excellent manners.
beats.hint: Howitzers and mortars are GROUND ONLY. Tripods, rifles and Parasols can hit air.
beats.when: first ground-only gun with no valid target

beats.text: A dotted line! That is a MISSILE! It has a lock-on and an opinion!
beats.hint: Dotted lines show homing missiles. Parasol Missileers are the only reliable AA: remove them first.

beats.text: The Spotter Balloon adds damage to allies inside its ring. It is fragile: keep it behind your line.
beats.hint: The Spotter Balloon adds damage to allies inside its ring. It is fragile: keep it behind your line.

beats.text: Kill Deputy Director Pellmell. He holds under the control tower.
beats.hint: Kill Deputy Director Pellmell. He holds under the control tower.

lines.text: LIFT-OFF! The goldfish is in the front seat! The pilot is in the back! The fish is, I am told, confident!
A fish at altitude. Is it the fish that is out of its element, or the rest of us?
I filed a risk assessment on the helicopter. It is already overhead. The form has a section for already overhead.

setpiece.notes: Fires at deploy (battle_start). Toy planes taxi and the Fishbowl Chopper lifts off past the camera with the goldfish in its bowl. Mission openers never cover the first volley; first contact is at 8 to 12 s.

lines.text: Pellmell is DOWN! The Deputy Director has been, I believe, redeployed!
A deputy has been brought down from under his own tower. Was it the altitude, or the clipboard?
He fell. The tower did not. I said which one was load-bearing.

extraSetpieces.notes: The general's death: a 3.0 s low-up on the control tower.

missions.designAmendment: AM-7: Plato and Cassandra lines of pellmell_falls added; air-only blind swap; see missions_notes.md

text.title: Harbour Tour (Mind the Barge)
text.blurb: Survive all four waves. The fourth comes with a barge.

briefing.text: THE HARBOUR! Four waves from the sea, and the fourth is a mower on a BARGE! You heard that correctly!
The medic mends the man, the mechanic mends the machine. Neither mends the argument. That remains my department.
The mower arrives on the fourth wave. It will cut a path. I wrote 'path'. 'Lane' sounded optimistic.

victory.text: The barge is aground! The mower has stalled! The harbour is trimmed and THANKFUL!

defeat.text: The mower cut a lane. The lane was us. I wrote lane.

stars.text: Survive all four waves. The fourth comes with a barge.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Have mines trigger at least eight times. Everything arrives by the same ramp.

reward.title: Harbour Master (Provisional)
reward.blurb: A wrench the length of a bench. It repairs nothing in the Workshop and everything in the matinee.

missions.botsWhy: A passive army with mines on the ramp and the pier roots and both support units behind the line holds the quay; the objective rewards patience.

blind.why: The blind army heals machines with the medic and runs out of both.

objective.text: Survive four waves from the sea

rules: Survive four waves from the sea. The fourth arrives on a landing barge.
A First-Aider's mint sparkle heals people only; a Spanner Mechanic's glint repairs machines only. The Tea Break god power does both, in smaller doses. Bring both units or neither stays up.
Star 3: mines must trigger at least eight times.

beats.text: The mechanic mended the tank. The medic looked at the tank. The tank did not mind.
beats.hint: A spanner glint repairs machines only; a mint sparkle heals people only.

beats.text: The medic mends the man, the mechanic mends the machine. Neither mends the argument. That remains my department.
beats.hint: First-Aiders heal soldiers, not machines.

beats.text: The spanner is OUT! He fixes the tank by hitting it! Success rate: tight!
beats.hint: Mechanics repair tanks, ploughs and APCs, not people.

beats.text: Heal and repair pulses reach six to seven units. Keep support inside the line, not in front of it.
beats.hint: Heal and repair pulses reach six to seven units. Keep support inside the line, not in front of it.

beats.text: Four waves. The fourth has a barge. I have said barge three times.
Everything from the sea lands on the ramp and the pier roots. Mines laid there trigger often.
beats.hint: Everything from the sea lands on the ramp and the pier roots. Mines laid there trigger often.

lines.text: A MOWER the size of a bungalow! Please keep all feet inside the garden!
It cuts a swathe, then another, for symmetry. Is a lawn a battlefield, or only a very tidy argument?
I wrote 'path'. 'Lane' sounded optimistic. It is a lane.

setpiece.notes: Fires when wave 4 begins: the barge ramp slams, the pull-cord roars (2 s) and the Grand Mower mows its first stripe across the quay. Crane-down at the ramp from (x 14, z -8, 14 u) to (x 14, z -36, 4 u).

text.title: The Dam Finale
text.blurb: Kill the Grand Teapot. It holds the crest and the kettle.

briefing.text: THE DAM! A teapot the size of a bandstand! A chandelier! A cabinet with a gun! I have run out of capital letters and am borrowing Plato's!
I have been speaking for nine missions. I now learn I was heard. This is unsettling.
The dam holds. Then it does not. I am so tired of being right about concrete.

victory.text: I was heard. I would like it noted that I mostly said that this was a bad idea.

defeat.text: You were put on hold. The hold was indefinite. I said so.

stars.text: Kill the Grand Teapot. It holds the crest and the kettle.
Win with at least half your army (by cost) alive.
Use cover, pins, armour hits, shells, mines, air kills and repair at least three times each. The Bingo Card is checked.

reward.title: Chief of Staples
reward.blurb: Everything Else: the page nobody wanted written. It is now in the Codex.

blind.why: The blind army ignores half the tools: no mines, no repair, no healing, and it runs out of time.

objective.text: Kill the Grand Teapot on the dam crest

rules: Kill the Grand Teapot on the dam crest. Its front shrugs bullets; the handle side does not.
A Chandelier Gunship arrives from upstream at 90 seconds; at 150 seconds the Final Notice bursts the left sluice gate. The Notice cannot hit inside 35 units.
Star 3: use cover, pins, armour hits, shells, mines, air kills and repair at least three times each.

beats.text: Star 3 asks for seven tools, three uses each: cover, pins, armour hits, shells, mines, air kills and repair.
beats.hint: Star 3 asks for seven tools, three uses each: cover, pins, armour hits, shells, mines, air kills and repair.

beats.text: There have been fourteen. This is the fifteenth. I will not read the paragraph.
beats.hint: A huge red ring means a notice shell lands in two seconds. It cannot hit inside 35 units.

beats.text: A gunship strafes armour and guns that cannot look up. Parasols, tripods and rifles answer it.
beats.hint: A gunship strafes armour and guns that cannot look up. Parasols, tripods and rifles answer it.

beats.text: The Teapot has not poured. It has only aimed. I find that more menacing.
beats.hint: The Grand Teapot's front shrugs bullets. Go round to the handle.
beats.when: first bullet on the Grand Teapot's front

lines.text: The gate! The Final Notice has served it! The water has been, how do I say, RELEASED!
The gate was opened by a notice. Is a notice a kind of key?
Concrete has a limit. The limit has a notice. I wrote the notice.

setpiece.notes: Fires from the script event final_notice_shell at 150 s (white-water sheet down the spillway, visual only). Plato label is PLATO from here. Victory coda, non-blocking: the crate on the crest opens in confetti, one sandwich arcs over the dam, the Parcel card follows.

lines.text: A chandelier! It is hanging from the SKY! Nobody dusts it!
Six toy planes on strings. Is it a gunship, or a nursery?
I filed a risk assessment on 'mobile'. It came back stamped APPROVED. By the mobile.

extraSetpieces.notes: Fires from the script event chandelier_arrives at 90 s. Low-up 4.0 s from the basin floor to the rotor.

puzzles.title: Duck, Duck, Cover
puzzles.blurb: Six tin hats, three sandbag walls and one very small yard; the walls are not where the fight is.
puzzles.hint: Creep from wall to wall: cover halves the incoming damage at every step, and the troopers cannot afford their reload windows.

firstSightBeat.text: Cyan brackets mean cover: hits from the front do half damage. A flanked unit loses it.

puzzles.title: Pin Cushion
puzzles.blurb: Ten peas, one machine gun and four reporters with a deadline.
puzzles.hint: Set up the machine gun before the reporters move; send the reporters only after the first pin ring fills.

firstSightBeat.text: Pinned units duck, cannot advance and shoot wide. Pin first, then flank.

puzzles.title: Plink, Plink, Crunch
puzzles.blurb: One tank facing east, six rifles that cannot hurt it and three gutters that can.
puzzles.hint: Keep the rifles on the front as bait while the three drainpipes walk the long way round to the tank's side and rear.
puzzles.goalText: Defeat the tank and its escort

firstSightBeat.text: Tank fronts shrug off bullets. Hit the side or rear, and present your own front.

puzzles.title: Too Close For Comfort
puzzles.blurb: One very large filing cabinet, eight small reporters and the rule that the cabinet cannot see anything near it.
puzzles.hint: Place the howitzer deep, set it up at once and screen it: it cannot hit inside 26 units.

bonus.text: Land shells on at least three reporters

firstSightBeat.text: Artillery cannot hit inside its minimum range. Screen it. Craters change the ground.

puzzles.title: Mind The Gaps
puzzles.blurb: Three tanks, one narrow gap and a small amount of tape.
puzzles.hint: Start laying mines the moment the column appears, in the choke, then get out of the road: mines arm after 3 seconds.

firstSightBeat.text: Mines arm after 3 seconds. Lay them early, off the lane your own units use.

puzzles.title: Cassandra Was Right About The Helicopter
puzzles.blurb: A gunship, two drones and a mortar that has never once looked up.
puzzles.hint: The mortar cannot fire at the air. Keep two Parasol Missileers behind the clerks, who are bait.
puzzles.goalText: Defeat the chopper and both drones

firstSightBeat.text: Air units fly over artillery. Parasols, machine guns and rifles can hit them.
